summary: An out-of-bounds snowboarder died in an avalanche near Battle Mountain outside the Vail Ski Area boundary; reported as the season's first avalanche fatality.
location: Battle Mountain (outside Vail Ski Area boundary)
notes: Reported in Thornton Weather's recap of the season's later avalanches; avalanche-center.org's 2009-2010 incident list independently logs a Jan 6 Vail-area skiing fatality.
